mapper.select: SELECT user_id, username, open_id, real_name, student_name, relationship, phone, avatar_url, role_type, dance_class_name, enrollment_year, remaining_hours, volunteer_points, status, created_at FROM sys_user ORDER BY user_id ASC

SELECT user_id, username, open_id, real_name, student_name, relationship, phone, avatar_url, role_type, dance_class_name, enrollment_year, remaining_hours, volunteer_points, status, created_at FROM sys_user WHERE open_id = #{username} OR username = #{username} OR phone = #{username} LIMIT 1

SELECT user_id, username, open_id, real_name, student_name, relationship, phone, avatar_url, role_type, dance_class_name, enrollment_year, remaining_hours, volunteer_points, status, created_at FROM sys_user WHERE role_type = #{roleType} AND status = 1 ORDER BY user_id ASC LIMIT 1
